newsitem.title: USA: Guardian Life seeks to buy no-load firm.
newsitem.headline: Guardian Life seeks to buy no-load firm.

text.p: Guardian Life Insurance Co of America confirmed it is looking to buy a no-load mutual fund firm.
A spokesman confirmed that Guardian was in the market to buy a fund company, first reported in the April 7 issue of Fund Action, a weekly fund industry newsletter.
Other details were not immediately available.

The newsletter quoted chief financial officer Peter Hutchings as saying it was seeking a no-load component because of what senior officials at the private Guardian perceive as demand for direct service.
Hutchings was not immediately available for comment.
While the company, which includes a unit called Guardian Investor Services that sells load funds, has considered starting a no-load business from scratch.
"It's much easier to acquire someone with knowledge of the market," Hutchings told the newsletter.
No-load funds are generally sold via direct marketing.
